name: 阴影时间分析
description: Analyzes shadow movement consistency over time
algorithm: Shadow Temporal — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes temporal shadow consistency for video deepfake detection:

1. **阴影检测&跟踪**: Shadows (both cast shadows and attached shadows) are detected per frame and tracked across time. Shadow regions are identified by their characteristic low luminance with preserved chromaticity relative to surrounding areas.

2. **阴影-光线Source一致性**: Shadow direction and sharpness should be consistent with scene illumination across all frames. The method tracks shadow direction stability — in constant lighting, shadows should remain directionally stable. Temporal shadow direction changes without corresponding light source movement indicate manipulation.

3. **人脸阴影相干性**: Facial shadows (nose shadow, orbital shadows, chin shadow) should be temporally consistent with scene shadows. The method compares facial shadow dynamics with background shadow behavior. Deepfake face generation may produce facial shadows that evolve differently from scene shadows.

4. **阴影Intensity稳定性**: Shadow intensity (luminance ratio of shadow to illuminated region) should vary smoothly over time. The method tracks shadow intensity — sudden changes in shadow darkness without illumination changes indicate temporal artifacts from frame-independent generation.

5. **Penumbra一致性**: Shadow edge softness (penumbra width) is determined by light source size and distance. Penumbra should remain consistent across the scene and over time. The method checks penumbra consistency — deepfakes may produce shadows with inconsistent or physically impossible penumbra characteristics.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through shadow temporal analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频

references.title: Zheng, Y. et al. (2021). Exploring Temporal Coherence for More General Video Face Forgery Detection. ICCV.
Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
